project.name: Clinic Appointment & Patient Management System
project.summary: A web application to manage doctors' schedules, patient records, and appointment bookings.
project.objective: Replace paper and spreadsheet booking with one central system.
out_of_scope: Patient self-service portal and online booking by patients
SMS or WhatsApp reminders and email automation
Integration with lab or hospital systems
Advanced analytics or custom report builders
assumptions: Each doctor's schedule will be clearly shown
A searchable patient record with full visit history will be kept
Manager will have simple numbers on appointments per doctor and per status
System will be secure, deployable, and responsive

semantic_notes: Sprint 1 tasks are well-defined but the goal 'Implement foundations' is too broad and may not cover all necessary aspects.
Sprint 3 tasks include 'Set up React project (+2 more)', which seems out of place as it was not mentioned in previous sprints and might be better suited for a separate sprint.
Sprint 4 tasks are mostly testing and setup, which might be better spread across multiple sprints to ensure quality and maintainability.
